nom: Mario Badescu Witch Hazel & Rosewater Toner

avis.texte: I absolutely love this toner! I love how my skin feels after using it. It doesn't feel dried out and my skin feels cleaner. I have a problem with Rosacea and this has been helping to keep it under control. Im now on my second bottle and will continue to keep this as part of my daily routine
Good toner! Super surprised about how big it was, great bang for your buck!

avis.titre: Def recommend for oily/combo skin girlies!
avis.texte: I decided to try this toner because my old one was not working. Immediately after use, I could tell my skin was agreeing because of the incredible glow it gave off. It didn't feel drying to me because I have combo skin. I noticed less production of oil the next morning. It was soooooo gentle! I absolutely, totally recommend this product for my combo skin girlies!
Smells fresh and is a nice toner for my oily skin. Not too harsh, but strong enough to do the job.
i dont really have sensitive skin, and this managed to dry my skin out and cause acne. smells nice…but that's abour it.

avis.titre: This product is fantastic! Gentle & cleans without drying.
avis.texte: I love this product and use it all the time. It has witch hazel in it, which I have always been a fan of using but it is balance with rose water. A fantastic cleaning toner without drying your skin out.

An employee at the store pushed this product on me after mentioning I had sensitive skin, thought it would be gentle. Smells like old granny and made my face more red and irritated after each use (once a week). Don't waste your money on this.
liked it at first but after using it for a while i noticed it was making my skin super dry to the point of flaking, even after serum and moisturizer.

avis.titre: I finally found a great Toner for my Acne Prone Maturing Ski
avis.texte: Does what I want a Toner to do without drying my skin. The Rose scent is light and leaves you feeling more refreshed after use.
All this does is make me breakout worse EVERYDAY. I had an Ulta worker recommend this to me instead of Murad's Toner and it was the worst decision ever. Dont get this. It's terrible

I love this toner! I typically use this one in the morning and the lavender one at night. It's a good value for the price (and seems to be on sale often) and there is a floral scent similar to their rosewater facial spray. In my opinion the lavender one has a more mellow smell, so if you're sensitive to smells I'd recommend that one instead.
It gave a burning feeling… good cleanser but painful so no worth it for me.

avis.titre: Can't believe how well this works
avis.texte: this toner removes so much grime I didn't know my cleanser was leaving behind. and the price point is very reasonable.
Leaves my face feeling amazing! Don't forget to apply your moisturizer after!
I love this product! For years I have been using Thayer's rose toner, but not anymore. This is the best toner I've ever used and the rose scent is so relaxing and beautiful.
This stuff feels like alcohol and fragrance diluted by water. Not for sensitive skin, it made mine burn when I put on any moisturizer.
This product has been a staple of mine in my daily skincare routine. No matter what time of the year, it's always included. It feels so nice on my skin even when it's dry.

avis.titre: Skin so smoooooooth! Read me if you have oily skin!
avis.texte: Read me if you have oily skin! I use this twice a day after Mario's enzyme gel cleanser, apply Clinique serum (clear gel with the purple pump for wrinkles and fine lines, their new product. Can't remember the name, sorry! ), top with Bioderma "mat control" pore refiner mixed with Bioderma "mat control" mattifying moisturizer. I'm *almost* 29 with oily T zone and pore issues, this regimen has been WONDERFUL after just FOUR DAYS. My skin stays clear, sans oily t-zone, all day in summer heat. Dermstore has a fabulous tinted sunscreen that makes my skin a mattified porcelain dream! I have struggled for years with acne, now I'm just tightening my fine lines and oily skin. Con: This toner makes my skin smell like a 90 year old granny's perfume. Pro: This toner makes my skin as soft as a 9 month old baby :)

avis.titre: One of my fav products ever
avis.texte: I've used this product for months and will continue using it. It's the best.

At first I didn't know about this product! After my first use it gave the refresher that my face never got with other products that I have used in the past and I can't do my skin care routine with out this toner. I would not use any other toner and it does the job for my skin I recommend that others try.

It's good, definitely my favorite of the Mario Badescu toners I've bought, but I won't be buying it again. As I learn more about skincare (only started taking it seriously a few months ago), the high levels of alcohol and fragrance in this product concern me; I have sensitive rosacea prone skin, and those things will irritate rosacea! The primary ingredient is water. I feel like I waste a lot of product because it's so watery; I have to use a lot to feel like I actually used any. If you want to stick with this brand, I recommend this for a toner on combo oily & dry skin, but I'm going to be looking at other brands for ingredients better for me personally.

I used this for a while because I loved the scent and it felt so calming. However, when I started learning more about skincare and that witch hazel as well as toners with alcohol can be drying, I stopped using this for a few days and my face has been way less dry and I've even seen a noticeable reduction in redness. So it turns out this was actually hurting my skin. But everyone's skin is different so those with oily skin might have different results.
This is literally fragrance with alcohol diluted with water. Zero benefit and can actually be irritating. A ridiculous product hyped up with marketing. No no nooo

avis.titre: Cleanse out the dirt right away
avis.texte: First toner I have ever used and it cleaned my pores right away showed what my wash couldn't clean

I absolutely love this toner. It's rise fragrance is absolutely beautiful, yet not too strong for those of you with sensitive smell. I have tried many toner including $40 brands to $5 bottles and this by far is my favorite. It is very gentle yet effective on my dry fall/winter skin.
This stuff is great if you have sensitive skin, acne or any type of skin problems.
Use after cleansing, and in the morning. Takes care of my middle-age, oily skin--but is gentle and non-drying.
It's smells good and is very softening. Removes makeup I didn't even see that was left over.

I use this on a cotton pad after I cleanse and let dry before I moisturize. The scent is pleasant, BUT the main reason this is the best is it leaves your face feeling so cold and refreshing! FEELS AMAZING!

avis.titre: Pleasing Fragrance, and a blast of refreshing
avis.texte: This is my normal toner I will use daily, it has such a beautiful scent and leaves your face feeling very refreshed
Toner was not harsh, skin felt refreshed and soft after using it. Light rose fragrance is not at all a heavy perfume fragrance, just nice and fresh.
I have used Mario products for over a year. I have tried 3 different types of his toners. This is my favorite
I have acne and scars. This product says it helps with blemish and but it actually made my face burn and my acne worse.
I use it as a toner. After I have a clean face, I take a cotton ball and squeeze some on and use it so over my face. I let it dry before I put on my moisturizer. Great product!
I only used it twice, but it made my skin oily and sticky. I think this product is designed for super dry skin.
this product leaves your skin feel rejuvenated afyer a nice cleansing.

the only good thing about this toner is the smell. tried it once in the evening after doing my normal face wash routine, it didnt give me the refreshed feeling that you expect from a toner. shortly afterwards made me so oily it was unbelievable. i couldn't even make myself give it a second chance.
This product is super gentle and can be used day and night. This is my new go to.

I love this toner! I have dry skin, and I get little breakouts here and there—this product hydrates my skin and keeps my breakouts at bay! I apply this toner every night and every morning; sometimes I'll even do it midday if I have any spots that are starting to appear. My only con is that the bottle top is a squirt bottle, and I find that I end up squirting too much product onto a cotton ball...so, my solution is to just screw off the top and turn the bottle over to quickly moisten a cotton ball—it's a quick fix. I love this product overall!

After about a week of using I noticed small breakouts around my face . I continued using and they continued to become worse. After I stopped using this product my face started to clear again . Because of this I ruled that the toner is the reason for my breakout . The only perk I see is the fragrance but that's also really strong .

avis.titre: Beautiful scent, great all around toner
avis.texte: I have combination skin and this helps to even everything out. It has cut down on my breakouts and evened out my skin tone. Easy to apply (I pat it on with my hands instead of using a cotton pad), great price, and a really beautiful light scent.

At first using this, I was in LOVE with the feel and smell, and thought I had found a gem for my oily skin. However after having break outs for about 2 weeks (I rarely get bad pimples), I realized this was the cause. As soon as stopped using my skin cleared up and has been back to normal since! Steer clear of this heavily perfumed formula.

I've been wanting to switch to more high quality products and I recently ran out of toner and tried Mario Badescu. I love this toner and how it makes my skin feel. I just bought two more bottles cos I started running out of the first one so soon

avis.titre: Weird black substance appearing at bottom of bottle
avis.texte: I wish I could pose this as a question rather than a review, but I use and rotate regularly between 3 or 4 different MB toners. I've had no issue with them except for the witch hazel & rose water one. I've begun to notice that when I don't use it for a little while (let me note, it states on the bottle it has a 24 month shelf life once opened and it is stored at the proper temperature along with all my other ones that I've had no issues with) it develops some sort of black cloudy growth at the bottom, which dissipates when shaken but reappears again days later. Is this a normal occurrence for certain ingredients to turn black and settle towards the bottom of the bottle? Or is it caused by mold/bacteria?? I only apply it directly to cotton and close the cap ALWAYS and I never put my hands or anything inside the bottle for any reason. I purchased a new one and months later, the same thing happened. I need answers lol

avis.titre: Great if you like a toner that drys your skin out
avis.texte: This toner dries your skin out like crazy! I feel very rushed to put my moisturizer and serum after putting this toner that just feels like scented rubbing alcohol on my face. The only two good things I have to say about this product is that it feels cooling on your face and that if smelled from afar it smells like rose petals which is a scent I enjoy.

I wash my face with my cleanser , then add this toner , then add my serum or face cream. Let toner dry a tad prior to adding ur serum/face cream. I also use this one particular in a spraying bottle as a facial spray versus the the other ones Mario carries. They are all good, but this one is my fav💕
Contains lots of fragrance and alcohol, like putting perfume on your face. Don't recommend.

idk if it's just me but i just bought this and i've used it three times and each time , it made my face swell and super red and itchy. and i don't even have sensitive skin and have never had a problem like this before.

I have oily/combination skin and have been struggling with bad breakouts again, but I changed my face wash and added this to my routine and my acne has gotten better. It's still not completely gone but my cystic acne has gone away and I feel it's a large part because of this. You can actually see the leftover dirt it's taking off on the cotton ball, but again it has not made a huge change in my acne.
I absolutely love this stuff. So refreshing and helps my dry skin.
I bought this for my teenage son for the acne and after the first week his acne is almost 100% gone. We used this on his back acne as well and saw immediate improvement.
This is my every day go to toner. Nothing else compares and I have tried many. I keep it stocked when it is in sale and tell everyone about it.
I love it, I will buy it again, it feels very hydrating and clean, it smells so beautiful, I feel like a rose garden !!

I've never cared to use a toner in the past, and I was never a fan of witch hazel. I've been using this toner for months, and I love it! It evens out and hydrates my skin, and I can tell that it makes my skin softer with each use. I think it's best for daily use to maintain the softness. It smells nice, and it's a light rose scent. Don't use too much, a little goes a long way. I apply to a cotton ball and apply after cleaning. Just let it dry and absorb before going to bed or adding anything else onto your skin after.
I use this product with a cotton round or ball to help get any makeup or bacteria off my face that I might have left with a makeup wipe or washing my face.

I really like this toner. Not only because it smells beautiful but also because it has an easy pour spout. I normally use the Mario glycolic toner but that one doesn't have a lovely smell. I also tried the ELF toner and it is a great budget friendly toner. I would recommend both.

avis.titre: I want to bathe in this product
avis.texte: This product smells so good and is great to take off residual makeup after using enzyme cleanser. I have sensitive skin, which toners usually don't appease, but this product is gentle.
I've been using this every morning & night. It hasn't broken me out - which must stuff does! My skin looks less red & irritated with this product.
Best toner ever it works immediately and feels great on the face without adding a layered feeling my skin is so clear and nice I will buy this stuff forever
I use the toner right after my face wash and it has the best feeling and smell.

I use this product at night and the morning. I use juice beautys blemish clearing cleanser, mario badescu botanical scrub, rose & witch hazel toner , and Mario honey moisturizer. This has completely changed my skin while also doing regular face masks. My skin feels so clean and soft all my makeup is cleansed by the end of the night and i feel my pores being cleared! Acne scaring is slowly improving, but no new pimples.

avis.titre: So glad I bought this product
avis.texte: I have noticed a huge difference in my skin after using this product! It gives my skin a natural glow after using it without making it look oily, while also evening out my complexion. I have super dry skin and it has helped moisturize it and feels light and fresh when applied. Another plus is it smells AMAZING!

I've been using this in the morning, it's not the best for my skin it does nothing for me. I see a little bit more of a glow it's been about a month or two and I still break out. Definitely be careful this one has a strong sent so please watch it if you're sensitive. I'm 20, with dry skin in the winter oily in the summers. Normal skin on and around my face. I have fair to light skin that's freckled and I don't see much difference. It just seems like colored water to me at this point I'm gonna keep trying I'll update later to see what happens.

Love this toner I use this after I wash my face with a cleanser. It's very refreshing and the smell is subtle. Price is great and lasts a long time and I use it everyday. I have sensitive combo skin and it works great for me.

I was really excited to try this product as I had heard great things about it. I have dry-combo, fragrance sensitive skin, and was hoping the product would help my acne flare-ups and texture. I started out using it only at night, and after about 2 weeks, I used it morning and night. While it did decrease the amount of acne, it emphasized and created more texture to my skin. I used it for about 2 months, but still, my skin's texture did not improve. I really appreciated the great smell and how refreshed my skin felt after putting it on. I would recommend the product if someone only has problems with acne and combination skin, but probably not so much for someone who suffers from texture like myself.

avis.titre: I can't live without this product in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I can't live without this product in my skincare routine! The Mario Badescu Rosewater toner and Rosewater hydrating spray make the perfect combo. It leaves my acne prone skin clear and bright! I'm absolutely in LOVE!!
I enjoy the way my face feels and smells while using this product.

avis.titre: I have used their products for many years - do a great job
avis.texte: Have used their products for many years-helps a mature face do a good job
Much better than the facial spray stronger the witch hazel is good for the acne and really gets all the remaining stuff off your face. And yet is gentle and good for your skin
Will return and go back to the Cucumber one I always use. Was trying something new. I love these products tho
Product is great. It arrived spilled in packaging. I ordered this item for an event & it was to be delivered on Friday. I did not receive it till Monday. Misleading.
Leaves my skin feeling fresh and takes off any excess makeup. Would recommend! My skin is normal to dry btw

I've been using this product for 3 days now (twice a day, morning and night) in conjunction with the glycolic foaming cleanser (which you are only supposed to use up to 3 times a week) and I've noticed a big difference in my skin tone. Not sure if it's just one of these products or the combination of both, BUT IT WORKS! I've also noticed my t-zone isn't so oily (I have combination skin). To me it has a light rosy scent but I'm not a person who is bothered by strong scents. I can see how it might be too strong for others. It's also a pretty decent sized bottle, which I would say justifies the price especially since the product does what it says.

I use this at night after washing my face, and it gets all of the excess dirt out of my pores without over-drying my skin. The scent smells FANTASTIC. Just like roses! It's subtle and refreshing. Will definitely be buying this again!

I use this toner morning and night (after using a cleanser) and I love it! I've been using it for more than two months now; it leaves my skin smelling awesome and glowing, works well with all the essences and moisturisers I put on afterward, and dries quickly without leaving my skin dry. I have pretty oily skin so I was hesitant to use an "all skin type" product, but I was not disappointed!
Nothing special. I have to use quite a bit to remove the last of the makeup the face wash didn't remove.
This is the best toner that I've ever used. It's perfect for sensitive skin & has a glorious rose 🌹 scent.
I've purchased more expensive toners thinking the price proved quality. Mario B rose toner is awesome and affordable! My new go-to!
I have been using this toner and it has really helped me with my acne and overall it leaves my face looking great without drying it. Highly recommend.
I use this toner every day. It smells amazing and refreshes my face in the morning without drying my skin.

I use this product everyday after I wash my face. It's gets all the dirt that my face wash missed. I've also noticed that it also reduces my pimples over night and it smells great! The only thing that I don't like about this product is that it can make your face feel oily/a little sticky afterward.
This toner is good for dry combination skin however in my more oily areas it doesn't do as much as I'd like to BUT I like it a lot because it takes off makeup and doesn't over dry my skin

I give 1 star by default, second star is for marketing/consumability. Did this product make me want to buy/use it, yes. The third star is for effect vs claim. I gave the star because it has appeared to cleanse my skin while retaining a "moisture barrier" (more on that in a sec). The fourth star is for feel/usability, how do that feel and is it easily able to find its way into my daily regimen? No. In short, it leaves a film that as other reviewers have put it, feel like your face grabs onto anything and everything that touches it. This does eventually subside by about 75% but it takes about 10 minutes to get there. Once you're at that stage, you're left with a smooth yet tacky surface of skin. Given that it's astringent, you don't want to mix your moisturizers with this, it'd eat them right up, yuck. Gonna have to wait. Considering a return, as I simply don't have 15 minutes every morning to dedicate to a product because it needs its sweet time to do a tiny job. For the record, the rose water spray gives me this same "sticky film" so it may be that. Last star is for ingredients. While I enjoy nice scent in my life, I don't very much enjoy the effect that the fragrance in Badescu's most popular products. They've left out any alcohol from this product, so my non-professional opinion is that these fragrances have nothing to evaporate them and are leaving behind the worst parts. Alcohol helps bind the scent to skin and then evaporates rather quickly, while the fragrance (broken d
This product feels very clean and cool on my skin. It smells great, and leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed.

avis.titre: Gave me a rash (small bumps on my face)
avis.texte: This product gave me a rash on my forehead. It took about a week to clear up I wouldn't recommend this toner to anyone.
I use this toner after I wash my face in the morning and night. I love the smell of it and it makes my skin feels really great.
It's so amazing. Doesn't burn or sting. Super smooth. Smells amazing! Feels amazing! The best I've ever tried!
I bought this for my daughter. She loves this because it does not dry out her face and leaves her face with a glow and feeling soft.
First of all, it broke my face out from the get go. I don't have sensitive skin but it did not agree with my skin. Second, the rose smell was unpleasant. This just wasn't for me.
I've tried alllll the toners, and even the top of the line-expensive ones can't compare to this. My skin is soft, clear, and the elasticity improved after three uses. Love it!

avis.titre: Best Toner I have ever used
avis.texte: I use it after a long day out, after taking off my makeup it gets whatever is left over. I use a cotton pad to pass it on my face.

I love this toner. It smells great and it is one of the most gentle toners that I have used. I have very sensitive skin and still have acne in some spots. This helped eliminate those trouble areas without the over drying that I experienced with other brands.
Live this toner. I got a travel size just to see how it does with my skin. It's only been about 2 days and i feel like my cheeks are clearing up already.

avis.titre: Must-try for acne-prone skin, love it!!
avis.texte: I've had acne problems for years and years and nothing has ever helped clear my face better than this toner. I had some cystic acne and regular breakouts and my dermatologist recommended I get on a prescription medication that had a lot of side effects. I'm so glad now that I'm not taking any intense prescription medication because after I started using this there is no need for it. This cleared my face so well in a really short period of time. I haven't broken out since I started using this product and it makes my skin look much better. I use it in combination with a Neutrogena face wash with salicylic acid and two prescription topical acne medications in the morning and night as recommended by my dermatologist. I highly recommend trying this before taking on more risky measures. I also bought my first bottle in January and have been using it every day since then and it is only halfway gone. Awesome product and I love it!!
I've been using this product for 2 weeks and so far its helped lighten my skin a bit and acne scars have started fading. I have pretty sensitive skin so I highly recommend this product!

I'm in my mid-30's and have fairly clear skin, but constantly had 1-2 pimples, especially around my chin. They were often deep, too, so you couldn't really get to them until they came up the surface. I don't wear a lot of makeup and have a fairly even skin tone, so I could get away with it. I live in a dry environment and have combination regular/dry skin, so I only wash my face at night before bed. I decided that I should start using more than just face wash and moisturizer, mostly bc of my age and hormone changes and all that bit, but I was also tired of always having a few pimples. I gave this stuff a try and BAM! Cleared up my skin. My face and neck feel much cleaner all the time, I use less moisturizer than I used to, and my skin tone evened out within a week of using it. I have had one tiny pimple since starting to use it two months ago and it went away within a day. I will be using this stuff for life now.

I've been using the stuff for A little over 2 months and it's amazing!!!! I used to have all these little tiny bumps and redness around my nose cheek area and it's gone. Took away all my little bumps and it's basically perfectly smooth and now! That Was my biggest and insecurity about my skin and it's gone now. It smells good and it doesn't dry my skin out at all. I just squirt some on my hands and rub it on my face and then put my moisturizer over it before It dries. I can't believe that it's this affordable and it did so much amazing stuff for my skin. I have very acne prone combo skin and it doesnt make me break out . In fact it has reduced my acne allot. Im so in love with this stuff.
Smells great and makes my face feel great and refreshed! Also helps with my little acne that I get.

Great price for the size and amount of product. It smells amazing and takes off whatever I missed after cleansing my skin. I haven't used a toner in a long time & I immediately noticed a difference. I have dry skin but sometimes I feel I don't need moisturizer after using this product.
I ordered this for daily use and am very pleased with it! It smells amazing, feels great, and makes my skin look fresh and smooth! I will probably be buying this again in the near future!

This has truly been a life changer for me. The past few years I have suffered from severe acne without being able to control it. I bought this in hopes it would help, it has done more than help. My acne is almost completely gone after using it every morning and before bed for almost two weeks. I will purchase this again!

Like other commenters I have used both witch hazel toners and rosewater toners on their own so i was excited to try this product. After the first use I got a severe rash on my forehead, I mean my entire forehead is filled with tiny red bumps that are unsightly. I don've have bad acne or anything like that but I do get occasional pimples. Seeing my skin in this condition is TERRIFYING!!! I hope these bumps go ways soon!! This was the only new product that I added to my face regime so I know this is what broke me out. Really disappointed!! I have used other Mario Badescu products and have loved them, but this really should be discontinued or come with a warning because it is not for all skin types as advertised.

avis.titre: not a witch, but works great on me anyway
avis.texte: was hesitant when i saw it was formulated for witches, but i started using it and it's works wonders on my skin. definitely recommend to everyone, even non-witches!
It smells so good, and it left my skin feeling hydrated and clean!

I have combo skin, not sensitive, with some acne. I have been using this with the acne cleanser everyday and my skin has gotten 100 times better than when I was using prescription topical gel for my acne. Would definitely recommend this! I'm already on my second bottle.

avis.titre: Noticeable difference after just one use!
avis.texte: I've been using this at night and I have already noticed a difference in my skin texture! Love it so much!

I was looking for a product to help with my redness, while keeping in mind that I do have sensitive skin and this is it!! I use this at night after I remove my makeup and in the morning after the shower. I have seen such a big improvement in the evenness of my skin tone, and have also seen fewer blemishes as this helps take out any dirt and oil my makeup wipes have left behind. I will never go without this!
Great everyday toner, doesn't dry skin out, very gentle, skin doesn't feel tight after use
This Rose and Witch Hazel Toner smells so good and feels great on my face.

avis.titre: Dye, Fragrance and black stuff floating around
avis.texte: I bought this and was super upset. I thought it would be better since it's one of their alcohol free toners but it still had dyes and fragrance. Also I had black stuff floating around in mine. Went back to ulta and noticed the same thing with the ones on the shelf. Kind of disturbing since I've never seen other witch Hazel toners have stuff in them and the same ingredient as their rose facial spray and nothing floating around in it.
This product smells wonderful and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.
I have utilized the Rosewater spray in the past, but this product combines the gentle cleansing of which hazel with soothing moisturizing of Rosewater

This works pretty well. I have sebhorreic dermatitis which is basically oily skin and eczema on my face at the same time. It's a balance for my skin. I don't feel dried out & my face looks brighter and cleaner when I use it.

As I've gotten older I've really began to enjoy the smell of roses, so I wanted to try this. It definitely leaves the skin radiant after using it, so much so the second time I used it I almost forgot I hadn't yet put on a serum and moisturizer. My skin was glowing in a healthy way. It leaves the skin feeling clean too, but without feeling striped. I really like it. I've been using it nonstop, and I think its one of those toners to have in stock in the cold months, especially if you have dry skin.
